name: Yancy Academy
excerpt: Yancy Academy is a private school for troubled kids in upstate New York.
notes: Yancy Academy is a private school located in upstate New York, known for enrolling troubled kids. Percy Jackson is a student here, and it is where he encounters several significant events, including the mysterious disappearance of Mrs. Dodds.
